text_en: Then Joshua son of Nun sent two men secretly from Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, especially Jericho. ” So they went, and entered the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and spent the night there.
text_cn: 农的儿子若苏厄由史廷暗中派出两个人作侦探说：“你们去察看那地和耶里哥！”他们就去了，来到一个名叫辣哈布的妓女家中，就住在那里。

text_en: The king of Jericho was told, “Some Israelites have come here tonight to search out the land. ”
text_cn: 有人报告耶里哥王说：“夜间有两个以色列人到了这里，侦探这地方。”

text_en: Then the king of Jericho sent orders to Rahab, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who entered your house, for they have come only to search out the whole land. ”
text_cn: 耶里哥王遂派人到辣哈布那里说：“将那来到你家中的两个人交出来，因为他们是来侦探这地方的。”

text_en: But the woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “True, the men came to me, but I did not know where they came from.
text_cn: 但是那女人预先将那两个人藏起来，就这样回答说：“那两个人的确来过我这里，但他们是从哪里来的，我却不知道。

text_en: And when it was time to close the gate at dark, the men went out. Where the men went I do not know. Pursue them quickly, for you can overtake them. ”
text_cn: 天黑快关城门时，他们两人出去了；往那里去了，我也不知道。你们快去追赶，也许还可赶上他们。”

text_en: She had, however, brought them up to the roof and hidden them with the stalks of flax that she had laid out on the roof.
text_cn: 原来她叫那两个人上了屋顶，藏在她屋顶上堆积的麻秸内。

text_en: So the men pursued them on the way to the Jordan as far as the fords. As soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.
text_cn: 来问的人便沿着约但河，直向渡口去追赶；追赶的人一出去，城门就关了。

text_en: Before they went to sleep, she came up to them on the roof
text_cn: 他们还没有睡，那女人就上到屋顶，

text_en: and said to the men: “I know that the Lord has given you the land, and that dread of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt in fear before you.
text_cn: 对他们二人说：“我知道上主已将这地方交给了你们；你们真叫我们害怕，此地所有的居民，对你们都恐惧不已。

text_en: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites that were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
text_cn: 因为我们听说，你们出埃及时，上主怎样使红海在你们面前干涸；你们又怎样对待了约但河东岸的两个阿摩黎王，即息红和敖格，将他们完全消灭。

text_en: As soon as we heard it, our hearts melted, and there was no courage left in any of us because of you. The Lord your God is indeed God in heaven above and on earth below.
text_cn: 我们听了，心都冷了，没有一人再有勇气来对抗你们，因为上主你们的天主，就是上天下地的天主。

text_en: Now then, since I have dealt kindly with you, swear to me by the Lord that you in turn will deal kindly with my family. Give me a sign of good faith
text_cn: 现在请你们指着上主对我起誓，我既然恩待了你们，你们也要恩待我的父家，请给我一个安全的保证，

text_en: that you will spare my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and deliver our lives from death. ”
text_cn: 使我的父母、兄弟、姊妹和他们所有的一切人，都能生存，救我们的性命免于死亡。”

text_en: The men said to her, “Our life for yours! If you do not tell this business of ours, then we will deal kindly and faithfully with you when the Lord gives us the land. ”
text_cn: 他们二人回答她说：“如果你不泄漏我们的约定，我们愿拿性命为你们担保；当上主将这地方交给我们时，我们必慈善忠厚地对待你。”

text_en: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the outer side of the city wall and she resided within the wall itself.
text_cn: 那女人于是用绳子将他们二人由窗户缒下去，因为她的房屋是在城墙上，她也住在城墙上。

text_en: She said to them, “Go toward the hill country, so that the pursuers may not come upon you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned; then afterward you may go your way. ”
text_cn: 她又对他们说：“你们要往山中去，免得追赶的人遇见你们。你们在那里躲藏三天，等追赶的人回来，然后再上道。”

text_en: The men said to her, “We will be released from this oath that you have made us swear to you
text_cn: 他们二人对她说：“如果你不这样作，你叫我们所起的誓，我们将不负责：

text_en: if we invade the land and you do not tie this crimson cord in the window through which you let us down, and you do not gather into your house your father and mother, your brothers, and all your family.
text_cn: 就是当我们再到这地方时，你应将这根朱红线系在你缒下我们的窗户上，并且叫你的父母、兄弟和你父亲全家人口，都聚集在你这屋内。

text_en: If any of you go out of the doors of your house into the street, they shall be responsible for their own death, and we shall be innocent; but if a hand is laid upon any who are with you in the house, we shall bear the responsibility for their death.
text_cn: 谁若走出你的屋门，他的血应由他自己承当，我们不负责任；但凡同你在屋内的，如有人下手加害他，他的血将由我们承当。

text_en: But if you tell this business of ours, then we shall be released from this oath that you made us swear to you. ”
text_cn: 但是你若泄漏了我们的约定，那么，你叫我们所起的誓，我们便不负责。”

text_en: She said, “According to your words, so be it. ” She sent them away and they departed. Then she tied the crimson cord in the window.
text_cn: 她回答说：“就照你们说的做吧！”于是打发他们二人走了。他们走后，她遂把那根朱红线系在她的窗户上。

text_en: They departed and went into the hill country and stayed there three days, until the pursuers returned. The pursuers had searched all along the way and found nothing.
text_cn: 他们出去，到了山上，在那里住了三天，直到追赶的人回去。追赶的人一路寻找他们，结果没有找到。

text_en: Then the two men came down again from the hill country. They crossed over, came to Joshua son of Nun, and told him all that had happened to them.
text_cn: 他们二人转身，由山上下来，渡过了约但河，回到农的儿子若苏厄那里，将他们所遇见的事，一一报告给他。

text_en: They said to Joshua, “Truly the Lord has given all the land into our hands; moreover all the inhabitants of the land melt in fear before us. ”
text_cn: 他们对若苏厄说：“上主实在已将那整个地域交在我们手中，因为那地方的居民对我们都十分恐惧。”
